elements.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
elements.evidence: Renewal is automatic, and not every conditional automatic-renewal element is met: the clause requires 60 days' notice rather than no more than 30 days and contains no Vendor reminder obligation.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: Each automatic renewal is for an additional one-year period.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out on no more than 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate/non-renew only upon 60 days' written notice, exceeding 30 days.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer at least 60 days before renewal.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation for HDI to provide a renewal reminder.

elements.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3 percent.
elements.evidence: The condition is absent: the rendered renewal language permits no price increase, and the compensation provision states a fixed 30 percent payment formula without a renewal uplift.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate/non-renew upon exactly 60 days' written notice.

elements.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
elements.evidence: The condition is absent: the rendered renewal language permits no price increase, and the compensation provision contains no renewal uplift.
